reason: The short sessions are better than I expected and the price is nothing, but I only stick with exercise when I turn up to a class with other mums and an instructor watching me. A home program and a group chat isn't that. I'd probably do a couple of the free sessions and then let it slide once work and daycare pick-ups take over.
objection: I know myself. With nobody physically there, I won't keep doing it at home, so even $20 ends up wasted like every other app I've downloaded.
would_change_my_mind: A live element I have to show up for, like a scheduled group session on Zoom or a monthly in-person meet-up in my area, so the accountability feels real and not just messages in a chat.
